task.title: Page recurrence occurrence histories through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/975 to expose bounded complete occurrence-history pages as deterministic read-only JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence ID, authored start offset, and bounded page size before storage access.
Emit sparse complete histories and next_offset in deterministic authored-offset order.
Open only existing storage read-only and fail with no partial stdout on selected-window corruption.

attempts.diagnostic: The CLI rejected occurrence-histories because the recurrence subcommand did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added focused CLI tests for deterministic sparse pages, cursors, validation, bounds, absence, storage failures, and corruption isolation.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded adapter.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented read-only page delegation and deterministic JSON, then shared one typed history-entry serializer between exact and paged adapters.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 975 in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests, README usage, ADR-0088, and scheduler documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found no blocking issues; a rate-limited CodeRabbit false green was excluded until genuine exact-head review completed with no actionable comments.
attempts.patch: Preserved the verified head unchanged through cooldown and required zero unresolved threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 975 delivered deterministic bounded history-page JSON while preserving kernel validation and read-only authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 976 exact head

lessons: Exact and paged CLI adapters should share event serialization while the kernel remains the lifecycle-validation authority.
No partial stdout is part of the trust contract when any selected history is malformed.
The adapter adds no write, global discovery, clock, persisted cursor, catch-up, lifecycle, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
